name: Krasnoyarsk
summary: The Krasnoyarsk programme studied reactor-antineutrino disappearance, weak interactions and deuteron disintegration in an underground reactor environment. Several detector configurations and baselines belong to this historical series.
detection_principle: Hydrogenous targets convert antineutrinos through inverse beta decay; neutron counters identify the released neutrons. Additional heavy-water configurations measured charged- and neutral-current deuteron breakup.
